stories.title: Texas halts new data center grid connections amid power demand surge
stories.summary: Texas has paused new data center connections to the state's power grid after officials found requested capacity had ballooned to over 400 gigawatts. The governor has ordered audits of new data center projects in response to the overwhelming demand, according to Ars Technica, TechCrunch, and Engadget. The move highlights the growing strain AI-driven data center buildout is putting on regional power infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: Power availability is emerging as a hard limit on AI infrastructure expansion, and how Texas handles the crunch could shape policy in other states racing to host data centers.
whatToWatch: Results of the governor's ordered audit of new data centers
Whether other states impose similar grid-connection pauses
How long the Texas halt remains in effect and which projects are delayed
questions: Which companies' data center projects are directly affected by the halt?
What criteria will the audit use to approve future connections?

stories.title: Trump administration's AI testing plan criticized as limited and vague
stories.summary: The Verge reports that the Trump administration's newly outlined plan for testing AI systems offers only limited detail, with few specifics on scope or enforcement. Little else about the plan's requirements or which systems it would cover has been detailed in available reporting.
stories.whyItMatters: The federal government's approach to AI testing will determine whether AI companies face substantive safety requirements or largely symbolic oversight.
whatToWatch: Further details on the plan's scope and requirements
Reaction from AI companies and safety researchers
questions: What specific testing standards or thresholds does the plan set?
Which agency, if any, will enforce compliance?

stories.title: Google Assistant set to disappear from phones next month
stories.summary: Google Assistant is being phased out on phones next month, according to The Verge, as Google continues pushing users toward its Gemini AI assistant. The report did not detail a full timeline for every affected feature or device type.
stories.whyItMatters: It marks the end of one of the most widely used consumer AI assistants of the past decade as Google consolidates its assistant strategy around Gemini.
whatToWatch: The exact shutdown date next month
How Assistant-dependent features like routines and smart home controls transition to Gemini
questions: What happens to third-party integrations built specifically for Assistant?
Will any Assistant features have no direct Gemini equivalent at launch?

stories.summary: Wired reports on gene-edited puppies developed to reduce the allergic reactions they trigger in humans, applying gene-editing technology to pets. The report frames it as a notable, if niche, commercial use of biotech tools beyond agriculture and human medicine.

stories.title: SpaceX's first public earnings report shows AI, not rockets, driving revenue
stories.summary: SpaceX released its first public earnings statement in 2026, and it shows the company generated more revenue from AI-related business than from its core space launch operations, according to Engadget and The Verge. The disclosure offers a rare look inside the finances of Elon Musk's traditionally private company.
stories.whyItMatters: It signals how deeply AI infrastructure and services have become entangled with even industrial giants built on hardware, reshaping how the company and its competitors are valued.
whatToWatch: Further financial disclosures from SpaceX
Investor and competitor reaction across both the space and AI sectors
questions: What specific AI products or services are generating this revenue?

stories.title: Study finds cougars reduce deer-related car crashes by hunting them
stories.summary: Wired reports on research showing that cougar populations help lower the risk of car crashes involving deer by preying on and thinning deer numbers near roadways. The study links predator ecology directly to a measurable public-safety outcome.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a concrete example of wildlife research translating into public-safety and economic benefits, feeding into broader conservation policy debates.
whatToWatch: Any policy proposals tying predator conservation to road-safety benefits
